sense: a person who lives next door

pins.definition: A person who lives next door, near your home, or in the same building.
A person who lives in the house or apartment right next to yours.
A person who lives next door or near you, or shares a room or apartment with you.

situation: A woman leans out of her suburban window to hand a garden tool across the narrow gap to the man standing at the adjacent window next door.
subject: the person living next door
brief: Two identical suburban houses sit side by side in cross-section, with a middle-aged woman in one window handing a small trowel across the narrow strip of yard to a man leaning out of the exact corresponding window of the house right next door.
